Boeing.statement: 10-K 0000012927-19-000010 · Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations: “Liquidity and Capital Resources”

comparable_facts: both filings are annual reports available before the same cutoff, but their fiscal periods differ (Boeing FY2019, Lockheed Martin FY2020); no period-equivalent claim is made
both discuss customer concentration and financing/liquidity risk as risk factors
not_equivalent: customer-concentration wording was not located in every filing, so it is recorded as missing data rather than treated as an absent risk
the two issuers use different liquidity and leverage vocabularies; no numeric equivalence is asserted and no ratio is computed across them
